jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Project Manager (Remote)

Location:
LATAM

Employment Type:
Full-Time

Salary: up to $2400-$2500

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Manager to support company-wide operations on behalf of one of our US partners, owning task management systems, workflow execution, and cross-department accountability through Asana.

This role is essential in ensuring internal teams stay on track with deliverables, deadlines, and standardized processes. The Project Manager will help leadership focus on strategic initiatives by maintaining workflow integrity, enforcing task accountability, and optimizing project systems.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, process-driven, and highly comfortable working inside Asana. Experience with e-commerce, Amazon Seller Central, and marketing operations is a plus but not mandatory.

Key Responsibilities:

Asana Workflow & System Ownership
Maintain and optimize Asana project structures, workflows, and templates
Build and implement Asana rules and automations to improve task routing and accountability
Ensure all projects follow standardized Asana best practices and company processes
Create and update reusable project templates for recurring initiatives
Maintain organized project boards with consistent naming conventions and task hygiene standards
Task Accountability & Deadline Management
Monitor task progress daily to ensure deadlines are met and deliverables remain on track
Audit projects regularly to identify overdue tasks, missing assignees, incomplete task details, and stalled deliverables
Follow up with task owners to ensure accountability and timely completion
Escalate blockers, overdue deliverables, and workflow issues appropriately
Ensure due dates remain accurate and updated with proper documentation
Cross-Functional Project Coordination
Coordinate deliverables across departments to ensure projects stay aligned and moving forward
Clarify responsibilities and streamline task handoffs between teams
Track cross-functional dependencies and resolve bottlenecks
Support operational alignment across marketing, creative, ads, brand management, and leadership teams
Reporting & Operational Visibility
Maintain Asana dashboards and reporting views for leadership visibility
Provide recurring project status updates, including overdue tasks and potential risks
Track workflow trends and identify opportunities for process improvement
Ensure leadership has clear visibility into project health at all times
SOP & Process Documentation Support
Assist in the creation and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
Document internal workflows and ensure processes are clearly outlined for team use
Update SOPs and workflows as systems evolve
Support continuous improvement efforts across departments
Other Duties as Assigned
Responsibilities may evolve based on business needs and trust built over time

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Proven experience in project management, operations, or workflow management roles
Strong experience using Asana in a professional setting (2+ years preferred)
Experience building templates, dashboards, workflows, and implementing rules/automations in Asana
Demonstrated experience using AI tools and automation (including "vibe coding") to build workflows, scripts, or lightweight tools that improve efficiency
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong follow-up and accountability skills
Ability to work independently in a remote environment
High attention to detail and commitment to maintaining clean systems

Desired (but not required) Skills & Qualifications:

Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central and the e-commerce landscape
Understanding of marketing operations, creative processes, and agency workflows
Experience working in a fast-paced remote environment
Experience supporting cross-functional teams

Benefits

Remote Work: Work from anywhere—our team is global, and we value work-life balance.
Growth Opportunities: As a key player i you'll have the chance to shape your role and grow with us.
Innovative Culture: Join a team that is passionate about leveraging data to solve challenges and drive success in a rapidly evolving market

As part of our recruitment process, all candidates will be kindly asked to agree to Lago's Confidentiality and Non-Circumvention Agreement . This ensures a respectful and professional experience for everyone involved.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.

With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

What You'll Do:

Partner with Solutions Architects and other internal stakeholders to manage customer implementations of Pigment, ensuring that customers understand the platform's value and attain a high level of adoption
Manage Project scope, timeline and budget and ensure all project contributors are aligned on progress and status.
Accountable for internal reporting on project progress and escalation when required
Responsible addressing customer requests for project resources
Anticipate risks and Issues and drive mitigation action to drive project success
Support Solution Architects through a collaborative project management approach, effective communication and consistent processes
Manage and maintain customers relationships, ensuring that all customers attain a high level of adoption and business value from using Pigment
Develop a trusted advisor relationship with customer executive sponsors to create passion and satisfaction for Pigment
Develop deep product expertise and creativity to work closely with our product team on the product vision and roadmap
Participate in updating Pigment’s project management methodology
Deliver awe-inspiring presentations and trainings, provide insightful practices and structure creative solution

Who You Are:

You have experience in deploying SaaS platforms across enterprise organisations
Significant experience in project management, sales or professional services at a software/SaaS company
Highly organised and strong attention to detail to make sure that deliverables and projects are completed on time
Ability to act as a leader and a team member first supporting internal project team members in achieving their tasks with minimal disruption
Ability to act as a mediator for stakeholders with conflicting requirements and help create consensus to move towards a shared goal and outcome
Ability to build commitment and excitement within the project team including external and internal contributors
You lead by example through showcasing empathy and strong resilience when facing setbacks
Display of growth mindset and constructive problem solving approach
Proven track record of building strong customer relationships, a deep sense of empathy and dedication
Experience in preparing and delivering presentations targeted to a senior audience
Ability to explain technical solutions, establish goals, develop opportunities, and provide reporting/dashboards to identify trends and improve the customer experience
Strategic thinker who is comfortable in a fast-paced, always-on, highly ambiguous start-up environment
Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to customer needs
Experience meeting multiple objectives in an entrepreneurial environment with little supervision
French and English language are essential
BA/BS degree required, MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred

What We Offer:

Competitive package
The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family
Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
Trust and flexible working hours
Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions

How We Work:

Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organisations

We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.

Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice .

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Adobe Project Manager - Work from home
jobs.description:
Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking an Adobe Project Manager
to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.
Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.
Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.
Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our Benefits ✨

Competitive USD salary.
100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.
Paid time off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary.
Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.
Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance.
Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.
Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About the project:

As we continue to grow, we are looking to add a Lead Project Manager – Digital Experiences to the team. This role goes beyond day-to-day execution, owning delivery strategy across multiple client accounts simultaneously and acting as the senior point of escalation and alignment for multidisciplinary, multicultural project teams, primarily within the Latin American market.

What you’ll do:

Lead and own delivery across multiple clients and scopes in parallel, setting priorities and resolving conflicts between competing timelines.
Serve as the senior point of contact for project health, timeline tracking, and status reporting across accounts.
Build, maintain, and adjust project timelines proactively, flagging risks and reprioritizing as deadlines and client needs shift.
Lead multidisciplinary, multicultural project teams, including internal stakeholders, Product Managers, and external agency partners (UX, wireframes, visual identity).
Manage relationships with Latin American clients, adapting communication style and delivery approach to regional and cultural nuances.
Conduct visual and functional QA on Figma files to ensure deliverables meet quality standards.
Manage Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Cloud workflows as part of the digital delivery process.
Communicate fluently and professionally in Spanish and English; Portuguese is a plus for regional coordination.
Anticipate downstream impacts of changes, connect the dots across workstreams and clients, and proactively surface risks before they escalate.
Negotiate timelines, scope, and priorities with multiple stakeholders and agency partners simultaneously.
Adapt quickly to shifting priorities, client demands, and organizational change.

What makes you a great fit:

Lead-level Project Management experience (beyond Senior), with proven ability to run multiple clients/projects at once.
Full professional fluency in Spanish and English (written and verbal).
Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Cloud — this is a must, not a nice-to-have.
Proven experience managing multiple clients and scopes in parallel.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
Experience working with Latin American clients specifically.
Familiarity with Figma, including hands-on visual and functional QA.
Experience creating and maintaining project timelines in fast-moving, multi-client environments.
Nice to have: professional fluency in Portuguese.
Highly adaptable and flexible in the face of change, with excellent communication and negotiation skills across cultures and stakeholder levels.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑 💻

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Delivery Manager, Platform

Location: Germany

The role and the team

As a Senior Delivery Manager (all genders), you'll own delivery for one of Lucanet's core platform teams — the team that provides the shared capabilities, platform services, and infrastructure supporting multiple product areas across the business. You're accountable for what ships, when, and at what quality.

Unlike feature-focused product teams, our Platform team works within a highly interconnected environment where changes can ripple across multiple solutions. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and Software Engineers to keep delivery moving, spotting dependencies, risks, and blockers before they slow anyone down. We look for people who keep growing, take real ownership, and lift the people around them.

What You'll Do

Drive project planning, coordination, and delivery activities across engineering & product teams.
Identify, track, and manage dependencies across multiple teams and initiatives.
Proactively surface risks, blockers, and delivery challenges, and facilitate resolution.
Coordinate communication between Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders.
Own the follow-through — drive decisions to closure and make sure commitments made across teams are actually delivered.
Support resource planning and flag capacity constraints affecting delivery.
Facilitate collaboration when operational issues, support requests, or competing priorities arise.
Help continuously improve delivery processes, adapting ways of working to team and business needs.
Define, introduce, and monitor delivery KPIs, quality metrics, and project reporting frameworks.

What You Bring

You have:

A background as a Delivery Manager or Project Manager who has owned delivery end to end — not just facilitated ceremonies. You take accountability for outcomes, timelines, and the decisions in between, across multiple software engineering teams working in Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid Agile setups.
A track record of running projects, not just meetings: you drive plans forward, chase the open ends, and make sure things land — rather than waiting for someone else to pick them up.
Solid understanding of Agile software delivery practices and SDLC processes, with the judgement to adapt them rather than apply them by the book.
Experience owning cross-team dependencies: mapping them early, negotiating the sequencing, and holding other teams to their commitments.
Strong stakeholder management and reporting skills — you keep Product, Engineering, and leadership aligned on the same picture of reality.
Strong communication skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, escalate when needed, and drive action when priorities shift.
Professional English communication skills.

It's a plus if you also have:

Experience in a highly technical SaaS, software product, or technology-driven organisation.
Experience supporting platform, infrastructure, or architecture-focused engineering teams.
Familiarity with Jira and Confluence.
Exposure to AI-enabled workflows, automation tools, or process optimisation initiatives.
PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, PMP, or equivalent Project Management certifications.

Perks at work

Flexible and hybrid working: our LucaFlex model lets you plan your working hours and location according to your needs and professional responsibilities.
Remote work from another country: work up to 90 days a year outside your home country, supported by our partner WorkFlex.
Professional development budget: get dedicated time, resources, and budget to build the skills for your career path.
Structured feedback process: Lucanet Engage supports your personal and professional development through regular dialogue.
Paid volunteer days: take the time to volunteer, alone or with your team, for causes you care about.
Health and wellbeing support: access company wellbeing programs, sport subsidies, and mental health support through external partners.
Health & Sports Support Benefit: additional health and fitness support.
Pension support: build your retirement savings with employer pension contributions.
Corporate discounts platform: get exclusive discounts across travel, retail, technology, and more.
Paid vacation days: take 30 days a year to rest, travel, and recharge.

About Lucanet

Lucanet is the CFO solution platform for modern finance and tax teams, automating processes from consolidation and financial planning to tax compliance, ESG reporting, and cash management. More than 6,000 companies worldwide rely on our easy-to-use, out-of-the-box SaaS platform. We're PE-backed and growing across global markets. 

Behind the platform is a global team of 900+ people who care about doing the work well. We challenge each other to move fast without cutting corners and build solutions that change how finance and tax leaders operate. If you want your work to have real reach, and your growth is important to you, Lucanet is the right place for you.

Discover more about Lucanet as an employer.

Powered by uniqueness

Everybody is different here and we like it that way. We welcome people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, national origin, religion, age, and disability, exactly as they are. What you bring is what matters. If you need an adjustment to take part in our hiring process, let us know. See yourself in this role? We want to hear from you.

Please keep your CV focused on your experience and skills, rather than including your photo, age or marital status.

Learn more about our DE&I journey.

Data protection

Your personal data will be processed in accordance with GDPR requirements. Find out how we keep your data safe: Lucanet data protection policy.

jobs.title: Finance Project Manager - General Accounting
jobs.description:
The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center is home to the General Accounting department, which supports critical financial operations, regulatory compliance, accounting accuracy, tax reporting, and stewardship of institutional resources. The Project Manager of Finance plays a key role in ensuring compliance with state and federal financial requirements while supporting strategic financial initiatives and reporting obligations.

The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center is a leading institution focused on cancer care, research, education, and prevention. The Project Manager of Finance will collaborate with internal stakeholders and external agencies to oversee payroll tax compliance, financial reporting, reimbursement activities, and accounting processes. The Project Manager of Finance is an essential contributor to financial integrity and operational excellence across UT MD Anderson.

The ideal candidate will possess a Master's Degree in Business Administration or a related field, CPA certification, experience supporting UT System operations, and extensive knowledge of the State of Texas Uniform Statewide Accounting System (USAS), Texas State Comptroller policies, and state accounting processes. A strong background in accounting, financial compliance, payroll tax administration, and project leadership is preferred.

Salary Range (40-hour work week equivalent): Minimum $123,000 annually - Midpoint $154,000 annually - Maximum $185,000 annually

Work Location: Remote - Must come onsite as needed.

Typical Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 8am - 5pm.

Why Us?

At UT MD Anderson, the Project Manager of Finance directly supports the institution's mission by ensuring sound financial management, regulatory compliance, and accountability to stakeholders. This role offers the opportunity to lead high-impact financial projects, collaborate with state and federal agencies, and contribute to a world-renowned organization while benefiting from comprehensive employee programs that support professional growth and work-life balance.

Employer-paid medical coverage starting day one for employees working 30+ hours/week, plus optional group dental, vision, life, AD&D, and disability insurance.
Accruals for PTO and Extended Illness Bank, plus paid holidays, wellness, childcare, and other leave options.
Tuition Assistance Program after six months of service and access to extensive wellness, fitness, and employee resource groups.
Defined-benefit pension through the Teachers Retirement System, voluntary retirement plans, and employer-paid life and reduced salary protection programs.

Responsibilities

Financial Reimbursement & State Reporting

Ensure reimbursement files are established in PeopleSoft HCM at the beginning of each fiscal year
Maintain reimbursement files and submit them to the State Comptroller's Office immediately following each on-cycle payroll completion
Manage reimbursement activities related to FICA, group insurance, ORP, and tobacco funds
Submit the Benefit Proportional by Fund Report (APS 011) to the Comptroller's Office and State Auditor's Office before November 19 annually

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Reporting

Oversee preparation and submission of quarterly and annual payroll tax returns
Manage filings including Forms 941, 940, W-2, W-3, and applicable state tax returns
Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local tax laws
Maintain current knowledge of UT System policies and procedures, GAAP, and GASB accounting requirements

General Ledger & Financial Analysis

Post General Ledger journal entries accurately and timely for state reimbursements
Analyze and review financial data to ensure compliance with internal controls
Identify accounting issues and areas of concern and recommend policy improvements to leadership
Process the Accrued Compensable Absence Report in HCM monthly and provide projected cost analysis to General Accounting
Provide annual current versus noncurrent ACA breakdowns for year-end AFR preparation

Audit, Agency Relations & Compliance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for the State of Texas Comptroller's Office
Serve as the primary point of contact with the IRS for payroll tax audit documentation requests
Manage tax notices, assessments, refunds, penalties, and compliance matters
Coordinate responses to federal and state agency inquiries and requests
Ensure adherence to internal controls and accounting standards

Account Reconciliations & Other Duties

Prepare accurate balance sheet account reconciliations for ACA accounts
Submit reconciliations by the end of the following month
Support compliance and financial reporting activities across the department
Perform additional duties as assigned.

EDUCATION

Required: Bachelor's Degree Business Administration, Healthcare Administration or related field.
Preferred: Master's Degree Business Administration or related field.

Work Experience

Required: 8 years Relevant experience in cost accounting and/or decision support with a hospital, consulting firm or related industry, to include three years of project management or supervisory experience.
Preferred: 4 or more years of experience with the State of Texas Uniform Statewide Accounting System(USAS). Knowledge of Texas State Comptroller processes and policies.

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS

Preferred: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) Upon Hire

The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center offers excellent benefits, including medical, dental, paid time off, retirement, tuition benefits, educational opportunities, and individual and team recognition.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Virtual PIR – Remote
jobs.description:
Lead the delivery of the Virtual Program for Initial Resettlement (VPIR) to achieve client enrollment and employment outcomes while ensuring high-quality, compliant service delivery in a fully virtual environment. Supervise staff, manage workloads, and provide ongoing coaching and training to support program success. Oversee program reporting, documentation, performance monitoring, and contract compliance while coordinating with partners and stakeholders to strengthen outcomes. Work closely with CWS Pre-Arrival and Post-Arrival teams to ensure alignment and compliance with PIR requirements and regularly collaborate with other Initial Resettlement Providers (IRPs) implementing VPIR services.

This role is subject to the continued availability of funding.

About CWS

Imagine waking up every morning with the chance to change someone's life. Imagine knowing your efforts will benefit both your career and our neighbors around the world. At CWS, our team knows they are making a difference every day. Whether you're in our U.S.-based offices supporting refugees, asylees or unaccompanied children ... implementing hygiene initiatives in Cambodia or rebuilding projects in Central America ... or even connecting remotely from your home on fundraising campaigns, grant reports, or critical communications - you have the opportunity to work towards a world where everyone has food, a voice and a safe place to call home.

Responsibilities

Core Duties

Program Management

Responsible for meeting program goals, client enrollments, and job placements as established by the contract guidelines.
Monitor general client well-being and conduct random sample reviews of client case notes and case files to ensure quality and timeliness of service provision and fulfillment of documentation requirements.
Ensure coordination among the different components of programming and community partners.
Stay up to date on program changes, best practices and funder requirements.
Ensure professionalism and quality employment service provision. Provide ongoing training to staff on program developments and service requirements.

People Management

Recruit, hire, train, supervise, and evaluate staff in accordance with CWS personnel policies and guidance from CWS Human Resources.
Promote teamwork, coordinate the workload of staff, delegate responsibilities, and hold staff accountable.
Provide ongoing training to staff on program developments and service requirements.
Develop trainings which include a detailed explanation of program services, including but not limited to; acculturation, adult education, employment, mentoring/youth services and immigration legal services.
Promote teamwork, coordinate the workload of staff, delegate responsibilities, and hold staff accountable.

Grants, Reporting, and Compliance

Coordinate and manage all aspects of the program including contract compliance, workflow coordination, quality control and the enhancements of services.
Monitor compliance of programs with program requirement and CWS guidelines and procedures
Complete required funder reports, coordinating with team members to ensure proper tracking and reporting of activities.
Prepare for and participate in on-site monitoring visits with leadership teams.

Partnerships and Development

Develop partnerships with local providers, volunteers, mentors and community organizations that support program goals and client needs
Present programs to employers, local school districts, state health clinics, state refugee coordinator’s offices, medical providers, and other relevant service providers

jobs.title: Project Manager, Long Haul Controls (Contracts - Telecommunications)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

The Project Manager, Long Haul Controls (Contracts)
is responsible for managing Long Haul Telecommunications (Dark Fiber) construction contract administration and commercial controls throughout the lifecycle of long-haul outside plant (OSP) deployment projects.

This role partners closely with Long Haul Project Managers, Construction, Engineering, Legal, Finance, and external construction and permitting contractors to ensure contracts are properly executed, contractual obligations are fulfilled, change orders are effectively managed, and projects remain aligned with budget, schedule, and commercial objectives.

The Project Manager
serves as the primary contract administrator for assigned projects while supporting risk mitigation, documentation integrity, and consistent application of company contracting standards. This position reports to the Director, Long Haul OSP Compliance.

NOTE: The team is open to this position working remotely within the United States. However, the preferred location is Denver Colorado.

Work Authorization Requirement:

This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Zayo will not provide, transfer, or assume sponsorship for any employment visa or work authorization for this position now or in the future.

Responsibilities

Contract Administration - Long Haul OSP

Draft, review, negotiate, and administer OSP construction contracts.
Coordinate with Legal to ensure contract language complies with company standards.
Maintain complete contract files, amendments, correspondence, and supporting documentation.
Ensure contractual obligations are understood and executed by internal and external stakeholders.
Monitor contractor compliance with contract requirements.

Change Management

Review contractor change requests.
Evaluate schedule, scope, and cost impacts.
Coordinate internal approvals.
Maintain complete change-order logs.
Support negotiations for equitable commercial outcomes.

Commercial Controls

Track contract values, commitments, and remaining budgets.
Review contractor invoices against contract terms and project progress.
Resolve invoice discrepancies.
Support monthly forecasting activities with Finance and Project Management.

Procurement Support

Assist in development of RFPs and RFQs.
Participate in contractor evaluations and vendor selection.
Prepare award documentation.
Coordinate contract execution activities.

Schedule & Risk Management

Monitor contract milestones and deliverables.
Identify schedule deviations affecting contractual performance.
Issue required contractual notices.
Support recovery planning with Project Managers.
Identify commercial risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

Reporting & Compliance

Maintain contract tracking dashboards.
Support internal audits.
Prepare contract status reports for leadership.
Ensure documentation supports regulatory and contractual compliance requirements.
Support federally funded programs where applicable (NTIA, BABA, Davis-Bacon).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Engineering, Construction, Supply Chain, Finance, and Legal.
Serve as primary commercial point of contact for assigned projects.
Promote standardized contract management processes across the organization.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's Degree preferred in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or related discipline.
Minimum of five to seven (5–7) years of telecommunications, construction, or infrastructure project experience is required.
Minimum of three to five (3–5) years administering construction contracts.
Experience supporting large-scale OSP deployment projects preferred.

Technical Knowledge

Understanding of OSP construction methods.
Familiarity with contract types (unit-rate, fixed-price, T&M).
Ability to interpret engineering drawings and construction documents is required.
Knowledge of project budgeting and invoice reconciliation.

Skills

Excellent negotiation skills.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Highly organized and detail oriented.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.

Tools

Microsoft Office Suite
Google Workspace
Google Earth (KMZ Files)
Sitetracker or similar project management software preferred

Estimated base salary range: $77,100 - $118,600 USD/annually

The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.

Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.

The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.

Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan
Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

As a Senior Project Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of complex initiatives within a broader program. Working in partnership with the Program Manager, you will lead planning, coordination, execution, and delivery activities across cross-functional teams while ensuring alignment with program objectives, governance standards, and broader strategic priorities, contributing to the success of the program. This role requires strong project leadership, disciplined execution, and the ability to build effective partnerships across business, technology, and external stakeholders. This role also contributes to program-level planning, governance, and continuous improvement efforts, helping to ensure successful delivery across a portfolio of related initiatives.

Success in this role means consistently delivering complex initiatives on schedule, proactively managing risks and dependencies, and fostering strong collaboration across both internal and external vendor teams when applicable. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound judgment, transparent communication, and a solutions-oriented mindset while providing the structure and leadership needed to drive successful project delivery while supporting broader program outcomes.

We currently operate in a hybrid working model, whereby you will be required to work in-office 4 days per week.

Location(s): Milwaukee, WI or Charlotte, NC

Responsibilities

Project Execution & Delivery

Lead the day-to-day execution of projects, including scope management, detailed planning, milestone tracking, and issue resolution
Drive delivery against agreed timelines while aligning with program-level objectives, governance, and dependencies
Coordinate across key stakeholders, including but not limited to Investments, Operations, Distribution, Marketing, Product, Data Management, Technology, and external vendors
Proactively identify delivery dependencies across projects and coordinate with partner teams to maintain program momentum

Vendor & Financial Management

Manage day-to-day vendor delivery activities where applicable, including milestone tracking, issue management, and escalation
Support contract oversight, budget tracking, and spend management at the project level
Escalate delivery risks related to vendor timelines, cost exposure, or quality to the Program Manager

Risk, Issue & Change Management

Identify, document, and manage project-level risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies
Develop mitigation strategies and escalate risks through established governance forums
Partner with business stakeholders to support organizational change management, including stakeholder communications and readiness activities across impacted investment and operations teams

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

Prepare and deliver regular project status updates, dashboards, and materials for program and senior stakeholder review
Facilitate working sessions, project meetings, and cross-functional coordination forums
Maintain clear, transparent communication to support alignment and informed decision-making

Documentation & Tools

Maintain comprehensive project documentation including project plans, RAID logs, timelines, and status reports
Utilize PMO methodologies, governance standards, and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams) to ensure consistent project execution and reporting

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

7+ years of project management experience within asset management or financial services
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives within asset management or financial services
Experience working with Confluence and JIRA tools
Experience operating in regulated environments with strong governance and control expectations
Strong execution, organization, and communication skills, including engagement with senior stakeholders
Ability to work at a computer and use standard business software for extended periods during the workday.
Communicate effectively with colleagues, clients, and business partners in person and electronically as needed.
Engage in regular in-person interaction and collaboration with team members and other stakeholders.
Work effectively in a professional office environment with ongoing collaboration, activity, and shifting priorities.
Maintain productivity and focus while balancing multiple tasks and interruptions common in an in-person business setting.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience coordinating vendor-led implementations and third-party delivery partners
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and project management best practices
Experience preparing executive-level presentations, dashboards, and status reporting
PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or similar project management certification
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field

Please note
: This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visas. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in The United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

Compensation

Base Pay Range: $145,000 - $160,000

Actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience, time in role, base salary internal peers, prior performance, business sector, and geographic location.  In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual discretionary bonus programs, or other annual or non-annual incentive or sales plans.)

Disclosure

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status

Job Description

Imagine getting your hands on new technology before it hits the shelves. To dig deep and ﬁgure out exactly how it works. That’s what we do. We lift the lid and test the boundaries on a huge range of products, from health-monitoring smart watches monitoring to electric vehicles loaded with the latest software. We’re always looking for people who are passionate about innovation, embrace change and love new and exciting challenges. Join our team, inﬂuence emerging technology and forge a successful career at the center of safety science.

Responsibilities

Managing the implementation of large and complex programs.
Provides overall leadership and support to one or more project teams.
Identify and implement process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, standardize best practices, and drive operational excellence across the organization.
Evaluate, develop, and deploy automation, digital technologies, and AI-enabled solutions to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and support data-driven decision-making.
Acts as front-line contact on program related activities, issues, and risks.
Manages risks and issues and takes corrective measurements.
Interfaces with C-Suite Executives, Business Unit Leaders and finance to develop ROI, IRR and other financial measures.
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organization, facilitating effective cross-functional collaboration to achieve business goals.
Partners with purchasing to develop POs and manages suppliers and vendor relationships.
Manages stakeholders' communication.
Defines the program governance (controls).
Plans the overall program and monitors the progress and performs daily program management throughout the program life cycle.
Manages the programs budget and financial performance.
Coordinates the projects and their interdependencies.
Manages and utilizes resources across projects.
May manage the performance of direct reports by defining accountabilities, establishing performance objectives and goals, providing feedback and guidance and ensuring that all policies are understood and adhered to.
Read and follow the Underwriters Laboratories Code of Conduct and follow all physical and digital security practices.
Performs other duties as directed.

Skills

QUALIFICATIONS

Demonstrated leadership ability, technical and business acumen and industry knowledge.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and proven ability to work effectively with all organizational levels, with Executive Level reporting and escalation experience.
Proven ability to build and lead integrated teams from various internal and external organizations across multiple sites.
Communication across programs, projects and areas (business functions and IT functions).
Background in the development of strategic and tactical planning of technology and people resources necessary for successful completion of several large-scale projects.
Ability to achieve broadly communicated objectives with a minimal amount of supervision.
Ability to promote innovative ideas and accept the risks that are required to lead change.
Ability to make decisions independently and to assume higher-level leadership responsibilities in critical situations.
Strong analytical, problem solving and financial skills.
Ability to innovate under new and/or changing conditions.
Ability to leverage AI technologies to identify opportunities, optimize processes, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Experience

Over ten years of project management experience running large-scale, distributed/complex projects with multiple parallel threads of work.
Experience developing, evaluating and submitting business cases for major capital investments.
Experience with cross geographical project coordination and management.
Experience with developing RFI/RFP and scoring mechanisms preferred.
Experience in Organizational Change Management.

EDUCATION

Bachelors' degree required; Advanced degree preferred.
Examples include: MBA, MA in Project Management, or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience.
PMP and/or Agile certifications preferred but not required with related hands-on delivery experience.

What we offer:

Total Rewards: We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. The estimated salary range for this position is $113,500-$150,000 and is based on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, as well as other factors. This position is eligible for annual bonus compensation with a target payout of 20% of the base salary. This position also provides health benefits such as medical, dental and vision; wellness benefits such as mental and financial health; and retirement savings (401K) commensurate with the standard rewards offered in each individual location or country. We also provide full-time employees with paid time off including vacation (15 days), holiday including floating holidays (12 days) and sick time off (72 hours).

A global leader in applied safety science, UL Solutions (NYSE: ULS) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. UL Solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. The UL Mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. jobs.description:
We are actively searching for an Education & Program Manager (EPM)
to add to our team. If you have experience managing educational programs and supporting meetings, conferences, and webinars for associations or non-profits, we want to hear from you!

We are excited to offer a flexible, remote-first work environment. Our employees work remotely across the country.

About  Impact 

Founded in 2006, we are an Association Management Company (AMC) that specializes in managing medium-sized associations led by volunteers. Our clients are associations in a wide variety of industries and range from local chapters to international organizations and professional societies. Learn more about us at ImpactAMC.com.

About This Role

This is a unique opportunity to work with a number of association clients to implement and project manage their educational programs.

The primary job of an Education & Program Manager (EPM) is to successfully develop and manage all educational programs included under contracted scope of services for their assigned client associations. While an EPM's responsibilities can vary depending on a client's size and structure, they often act as a primary point of contact and are responsible for fulfilling daily program and event-related needs and ensuring smooth functioning of their client teams.

As a member of the Impact Events Team, EPMs are also responsible for supporting effective execution of event-related needs for their clients.

Job duties include, but are not limited to:

Educational Program Management:
Develop and manage educational programs for conferences, annual meetings, seminars, and other learning events.
Manage abstract and proposal processes, including calls for submissions, review processes, and communications.
Manage speakers, including invitations, communications, biographies, disclosures, presentations, and deadlines.
Develop and maintain conference agendas, educational tracks, and session schedules, and provide strategic recommendations to strengthen and enhance existing client education programs.
Manage the conference poster process, including poster selection, presenter communications, coordination, scheduling, and preparation of final poster materials.
Coordinate, edit, proofread, and review education related conference and webinar materials, including programs, agendas, speaker biographies, educational content, and related communications.
Support webinar programming, including topic development, speaker coordination, scheduling, technology/platform coordination, and post-event activities.
Own continuing education (CE) and credentialing processes, including documentation, applications, attendance, evaluations, certificates, and reporting.
Support education and program committees and volunteer leaders as needed and as outlined within a client's scope of services.
Maintain program timelines and ensure educational deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.
Program Strategy and Enhancement
Identify opportunities to improve and standardize education/program processes across client accounts.
Standardization of meetings for accreditation purposes.
Meeting Planning work, as needed. Including, but not limited to:
Develop and execute event marketing and communications, including content development, client mailings, and promotional materials.
Manage event registration platforms and technology, and maintain event content across websites, databases, learning systems, and other platforms.
Coordinate meeting committees, speakers, sponsors, and assigned team members while keeping client teams informed of priorities and progress.
Develop event strategies that support client goals, increase attendance and revenue, and ensure successful execution across internal and external teams.
Other duties as assigned.

This job also requires travel, as you will be expected to attend client events and professional development conferences throughout the year.

Pay range for this position: $24 - $26 per hour

Requirements

Required experience: 

Minimum of 3 years of program management experience
Professional meeting management experience
Experience working with nonprofit organizations/associations
Associate's degree

This is a full-time, 40 hour/week position and employees must be consistently available during Impact's core work hours: 9:00am - 3:00pm Central Time.

Benefits

Why work for Impact?

We offer a challenging and fun environment, an amazing team, and opportunities for advancement. We are a quickly growing company and value our employee's input, suggestions, and feedback. You will feel valued, motivated, challenged, and encouraged!

Benefits include:

A flexible work environment:

The opportunity to work remotely
Four hours of flex time each week
Optional half-day on Fridays once all hours are completed

Unique company holidays and time off:

Impact offices close for a full week of paid holiday time:
At the end of June for our annual "Summer Break"
Between Christmas Eve and New Years Day
All employees receive one day of paid PTO to use as a "floating holiday" each year

Continuous learning and growth:

Regular paid professional development opportunities
Opportunities for advancement and internal movement

Opportunities to connect with coworkers:

Monthly social events and regular team activities such as games, book clubs, informal chats, and more
Paid group volunteer opportunities with local organizations

Knowing you are valued member of the team:

Open and accessible communication with leadership
Encouraged company-wide recognition
An inclusive work environment

Additional benefits:

Paid time off, medical, dental, vision, 401K, paid holidays, life insurance, short/long term disability, and wellness
Company-provided equipment and technology

See more about our benefits at ImpactAMC.com!

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Hoover Institution
seeks a Research Program Manager/Portfolio Specialist
to support and operationally energize the policy and research agenda of the Technology and Manufacturing Leadership (TML) team, a new Hoover program operating within the Commons Initiative.

TML is focused on producing research and reality-based, actionable outputs dedicated to how the US and its allies and partners can maintain technology and manufacturing leadership. TML’s research agenda centers on identifying and exploring opportunities to advance innovation and production capability across several industrial sectors. TML will consider how to deploy strategic capitalism and a whole-of-nation approach to technological transformation, how to forge deeper cooperation with democratic nations to implement, and how to assess and activate the full stack of factors that contribute to the ability to make complex products. Several workstreams are being developed, including semiconductors, industrial biomanufacturing, and advanced manufacturing, as well as research tools that drive technological innovation.

The Research Program Manager/Portfolio Specialist role is to develop, implement, and administer the vision, strategy, and goals of the team’s portfolio. The program is in its ramp-up phase. Ideal candidates are self-directed, organized, and accountable in dynamic, highly collaborative environments. Positivity, resilience under pressure, and strong problem-solving skills are essential. The role requires someone who brings consistent energy and humility to the team. Program management experience, strong writing skills and budget oversight are preferred but not required. Competence in visual display tools and tech literacy is an asset. Expertise in adjacent domains—political science, economics, law, engineering—is equally welcome with demonstrated willingness to learn the technology landscape.

Studies have shown that people from certain backgrounds are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they can perform every job description task. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may come from a less traditional background. We may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

The position is not a research position, but an operational role.

A cover letter and resume are required for full consideration.

This position is a two-year fixed term contract.

WORK ARRANGEMENT:
This position will be based on the Stanford campus and may be considered for an option of one or two day/week telecommuting (hybrid of working on-site and off-site), subject to operational need.

CORE DUTIES*:

Develop and manage the program operations associated with scheduling, organizing, and operating.
Manage program activities, including outreach to varied stakeholders within the program, assigning resources and making program improvement recommendations that impact policies and programs.
Manage public programs from inception through completion, including speaker and participant coordination, logistics, budgeting, and related activities; oversee research efforts and evaluate programs; and collect and analyze data to assess effectiveness and support recommendations for improvement.
Write and/or edit complex content for newsletters, email communications, policy reports, peer-reviewed publications, proposals, research grants, fundraising and other program outputs.
Monitor program expenses, budgets, and finances, and make recommendations on funding based on program spending.
Source, collect and analyze data; review and explain trends; identify and recommend new collaboration opportunities; formulate and evaluate alternative solutions and/or recommendations to achieve the goals of the program or function.
Coach and mentor program staff, including student research assistants.

Preferred/Desired Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Able to work comfortably with frontier technologies subject matter and industrial manufacturing themes.
Capable of managing, completing, and shipping complex and high-consequence projects and work products on time.
Able to support and prepare principles for meetings, briefings, hearings, or discussions .

Working Conditions

May work extended hours, evenings or weekends.
May be asked to travel locally, nationally, and internationally.
Occasional overnight travel.

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Oversee and administer research activities by evaluating academic programs, making recommendations that impact policies and programs, and coordinating and implementing changes.
Collect and analyze data, create reports, review and explain trends to determine program effectiveness; formulate and evaluate alternative solutions and/or recommendations to achieve the goals of the program.
Teach and/or assist in the teaching and administration of courses. Create and/or advise in the development of curriculum. Make recommendations for course improvements.
Write and edit content for proposals, peer-reviewed publications, and other program activities under the general direction of PI. Assist with the development of research grants, (i.e., may suggest new funding opportunities, write portions of grants, and/or summarize data for grant support).
Represent the program or function as the key contact and subject matter expert within the department, unit or school and develop communications for internal and external constituencies. Organize and/or participate in outreach activities such as events, partnerships, fundraising, training, and conferences. Lead workshops and facilitate meetings.
Monitor expenses, budgets, and finances of the program. Make recommendations on funding based on program spend.
May oversee and train student workers.

Minimum Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree and two years of relevant experience or combination of education, training, and relevant experience. Advanced degree may be required for some programs. Program administration and or research experience may be required.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Demonstrated oral, written, and analytical skills, exhibiting fluency in area of specialization.
Ability to oversee and provide basic direction to staff.

Certificates And Licenses Required

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Certifications and Licenses:

Series 7 , 63 or 66 required within 2 years.
Series 65 preferred

Internal Application Policy:

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Benefits to support you:

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Kestra Values:

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

Explore Life at Kestra

Careers Portal: https://jobs.dayforcehcm.com/en-US/kestra/KESTRACAREERSITE

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/kestra-financial

Lead with purpose. Apply now and help shape the future of Kestra.
